scope: Only the previously inspected Im4 rectangle, all three thresholds. Largest component versus every other retained component. No model assignment required for this geometric calculation.

initial_error.description: Directional subtraction incorrectly assumed the largest component was above the others. Negative values were printed as nonpositive gaps; they must not be interpreted as overlap. No underlying pixels changed.

corrected_method: Treat inclusive pixel run [a,aa] as closed cell-edge interval [a,aa+1]. For another [b,bb+1], unsigned separation is max(0,b-aa-1,a-bb-1). At each shared x take the minimum across all pairs of runs. Report every threshold, not a selected best case.
limits: Only selected neutral pixels: undetected ink and compression artifacts are not bounded by these gaps.
A footprint span includes slope within one native column and is not perpendicular linewidth or centreline uncertainty.
Shared column counts are not admitted continuous displacement intervals; gaps remain gaps.
No calibrated graph uncertainty, physical ordinates, engineering discrepancy, human acceptance or causal ranking.
